About.title: About Me
About.bioParagraph1: I started my career as a radiographer in healthcare before moving into software development. Today, I work as a fullstack developer, combining my experience from healthcare with a passion for building software.
About.bioParagraph2: I enjoy working across the full stack, from creating clean and intuitive interfaces to developing the backend systems and integrations that make everything work together.
About.philosophyQuote: I like keeping things simple. My approach is influenced by Scandinavian design: clean, functional and user-friendly, with tones inspired by nature.
About.frontendSkills: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js, Tailwind CSS, Asp Net MVC, BootStrap

CV.title: Career Overview
CV.biographyParagraph1: I come from a background in healthcare, leadership and sales. Today, I work as a Software Developer, where I develop and maintain solutions across the .NET ecosystem. My work includes fullstack development, SQL Server, external API integrations and improving existing systems.
CV.biographyParagraph2: Outside of work, I spend time exploring modern frontend development and building personal projects with technologies such as Next.js.

CrawlableSummary.heading: Johannes Brannelid — Fullstack Developer
CrawlableSummary.bio: I come from a background in healthcare, leadership and sales. Today, I work as a Software Developer at Alma Health AB, where I develop and maintain solutions across the .NET ecosystem. My work includes backend development, SQL Server, external API integrations and improving existing systems. Outside of work, I spend time exploring modern frontend development and building personal projects with technologies such as Next.js, React, TypeScript and Three.js.
